environment.description: Kubernetes pod running in namespace 'data-jobs' on EKS cluster. Pod uses default service account with IAM role attached via IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts). No network restrictions applied. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with default securityContext. Multiple pods from different teams share the same node. The /tmp directory is backed by the node's ephemeral storage (emptyDir not used, hostPath /tmp mounted for legacy compatibility).
